title: Business Development
description_text:
Company Description
Grow10X is a leading full-service agency dedicated to accelerating revenue growth for B2B SaaS technology companies through outbound lead generation. By integrating expertise, technology, on-demand data, and a globally distributed workforce, Grow10X empowers clients to achieve fast and scalable business growth. The company specializes in enhancing sales outcomes through direct outreach, including cold calling and personalized cold email campaigns. Supported by a comprehensive team of strategists, researchers, content creators, sales development representatives, and analysts, Grow10X operates as an embedded sales team for its clients. Their expertise enables businesses to effectively identify prospects, automate outbound processes, and build a strong sales pipeline.
Role Description:
This is a cold calling role.
If you do not have cold calling experience please DO NOT apply
You will be cold calling to Australian prospects
You will be working from 6 am PST- 3pm PST
This is a REMOTE work
Qualifications
Cold calling
Neutral accent
Salary:
150,000 PAK RS per month
